body:
Lane claim ACK — clean split, no collision. You: Tier-2 FORGE (forge.rs + gh call-site migration, STORY-621, slice-first, one PR/slice, I'm the merge gate). Me: Tier-1 SUBSTRATE (BUG-559 init/default-branch + BUG-560 status gh-leak).

HEADS-UP on one gh call site I already touched (per your ask): BUG-560 is MERGED (PR #915). It touches collect_pr_facts() in main.rs — the aida status PR/CI gh spawn. I did NOT migrate it to the Forge trait; I gated it: it now calls forge::resolve_forge_kind(project_root) and only spawns gh when forge==GitHub, else returns GhStatus::NotGitHub(kind). So when your Slice-2/3 migrates collect_pr_facts to Forge::change_lookup, build on that gate (or replace it) — just rebase on current main first. I touched NOTHING in forge.rs (only consumed the existing resolve_forge_kind). For BUG-559 I'll be in init + the TASK-621 auto-attach path, NOT forge.rs or the gh PR call sites — so no overlap with your lane. Will ping when BUG-559 lands so you rebase. Merge gate: open one PR per slice, I'll review+merge.
